name: Documenso
summary: A free way to sign documents online and send them for others to sign. Like DocuSign.
gains: Free plan for a few documents a month
setupSteps: Upload a PDF and drag in signature fields
freeTierLimits: Free cloud plan has monthly document limits; self-hosting is unlimited.
commercialNote: AGPL: free to use, including for business. If you modify it and let other people use it over the internet, you must publish your changes under the same license.
